title: Upper tail large deviation for the first passage time in the frog model on $Z^d$ with $d\geq 2$
summary: We study upper tail large deviations for the first passage time in the frog model on $\mathbb Z^d$, $d\ge 2$. Let $\mathrm{T}(0,x)$ denote the first time at which the infection, started from the origin, reaches $x$, and let $μ$ be the associated time constant.
